g.text: encode session, expiry, and next position
bound session, expiry, and next position
later appends when they follow the cursor
encode next position if more remain
and tool.result entries on the current branch are public.
Items are sorted by entry_seq ascending.
There is no fixed snapshot watermark. Later persisted
entries may become eligible on a subsequent page.
next_page null means no more persisted events at response time.
It does not mean the Session cannot append future events.
An invalid or expired page returns 400 INVALID_EVENT_LIST_QUERY.
